course.name: MBChB Medicine
course.notes: A100 is the standard five-year MBChB Medicine course. Keele A104 Health Foundation Year for Medicine remains a separate UCAS course and is not mixed into this A100 profile.

by_selection_route.keele_home_a100_shortlisting_score: Home applicants are shortlisted using Keele's 25-point score, combining a UCAT, SJT and bonus-point component with Keele's personal-statement score.
by_selection_route.keele_home_contextual_shortlisting_score: Contextual Home applicants are shortlisted using Keele's 25-point score, including the published contextual point adjustment where verified.
by_selection_route.keele_international_ucat_ranked: International applicants who meet the academic, UCAT and SJT requirements are ranked by UCAT total.
by_selection_route.keele_steps2medicine_ukwpmed_guaranteed_: Verified Home Steps2Medicine or UKWPMED applicants receive a guaranteed interview after meeting Keele's minimum GCSE, UCAT and SJT requirements.

medical_school.name: Keele University School of Medicine
medical_school.notes: Rules are mapped from the supplied Keele A100 official-source research pack for 2027 entry.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Home applicants must clear the GCSE and UCAT/SJT gates, then are shortlisted on Keele's UCAT/SJT/bonus-point component plus a personal-statement score out of 15, producing a score out of 25.
International applicants are ranked separately by UCAT total only after the International UCAT minimum and SJT gate.
Verified Steps2Medicine or UKWPMED completers receive guaranteed interview handling only where the minimum GCSE and UCAT/SJT requirements are met.
A104 is a separate gateway/foundation course and must not be evaluated through this A100 profile.

overall_policy.description: Keele A100 first checks GCSE, post-16, UCAT and SJT eligibility. GCSEs are gates only, not scored. Home applicants have a 1700 UCAT floor; International applicants have a 1950 floor; SJT Band 4 is an automatic rejection.
not_eligible_if: Minimum GCSE requirements are not met.
Home UCAT total is below 1700 or International UCAT total is below 1950.
The course target is A104 rather than A100.
The applicable post-16 academic route is not met.

science_requirement.notes: Biology plus Chemistry without Physics is explicitly not accepted for the separate-science route.

accepted_equivalencies: IGCSE co-ordinated sciences or double award at 66/BB
gcse.sitting_policy: GCSE requirements must be met before applying.
gcse.notes: GCSEs are eligibility gates only and are not part of Keele's numerical shortlisting score.

grade_requirements.notes: Economics is an accepted Keele second subject but has no Engine v1.0 canonical subject identifier; Economics-bearing profiles are a manual-review boundary.

standard_offer.notes: AAA plus EPQ grade A is an accepted alternative but is not executable in the generic classifier.

contextual_offer.notes: Contextual applicants receive a one-grade-lower offer; they do not receive a lower UCAT threshold.

a_level.third_subject_rules: Third A-level may be any other academic subject; General Studies and Critical Thinking are excluded.
a_level.notes: Applications are not considered from students who have taken more than three years to complete three A-levels; this timing rule remains a manual-review boundary.

ib.notes: Standard IB route requires 37 points including TOK/EE and 766 in HL subjects including Biology or Chemistry plus a second accepted subject.

higher_offer.notes: AAAAA by end of S5 including Chemistry/Biology plus a second science.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: AB from two science subjects in S6.

scottish.notes: Mapped as official evidence but left as manual review because the generic classifier cannot jointly evaluate Keele's S5/S6 profile safely.

degree.notes: Graduate applicants apply through A100 but require a degree plus BBB/GAMSAT route checks that are not executable as a single generic route in Engine v1.0.

post_16.notes: A-level and IB school-leaver routes are represented for supported subject identifiers. Scottish, graduate, EPQ and Economics-second-subject routes are documented manual-review boundaries.

ucat.notes: ApplySmart enforces Keele's applicant-group-specific UCAT hard floors through the generic group-aware UCAT minimum mechanism: Home applicants require at least 1700 and International applicants require at least 1950.

scoring.notes: Keele uses SJT in the UCAT-grade component for Home applicants, but the full UCAT/SJT/bonus table is not executable in Engine v1.0.

sjt.notes: SJT Band 4 is an automatic rejection.

resits.policy: A-level applicants taking more than three years to complete three A-levels are not considered except in limited accepted circumstances.
conditions: GCSE requirements must be met before applying.
A-level completion timing beyond three years requires individual review.

accepted_tests: TOEFL iBT 100 with Keele subtest minimums
english_language.notes: International English-language evidence is required unless a listed exemption is met.

age_or_professional_checks.age_date: 1 October of year of entry to Year 1
age_or_professional_checks.notes: Offer-holder checks are not interview prediction.

ranking_factors.notes: Home score combines Keele's UCAT-grade component, bonus points and a personal-statement score out of 15.
International applicants are ranked by UCAT total only.

score_components.calculation_method: Keele UCAT quintile points plus SJT band points plus documented bonus points
score_components.notes: The exact operational quintile table is not represented by an Engine v1.0 component.

score_components.calculation_method: Keele-scored personal statement against five person-specification criteria
score_components.notes: ApplySmart cannot invent or calculate Keele's personal-statement score.

total_score.notes: Known guidance is around 15/25, with 14/25 possible where UCAT Verbal Reasoning is at least 600.

calculation.notes: The official Home formula is documented, but ApplySmart cannot calculate the PS score or Keele's UCAT-grade quintile component without a supplied Keele score or future supported component.

thresholds.notes: Around 15/25; 14/25 was possible if UCAT Verbal Reasoning was at least 600.
International applicants below this floor are not eligible. ApplySmart enforces this through the generic applicant-group-specific UCAT minimum mechanism.

selection_adjustments.adjustment: +1 point in the UCAT-grade component and one-grade-lower offer
selection_adjustments.notes: Contextual applicants do not receive a lower UCAT threshold.

selection_adjustments.adjustment: Verified Steps2Medicine/UKWPMED completers receive guaranteed interview handling where minimum GCSE and UCAT/SJT requirements are met.
selection_adjustments.notes: This is not a general contextual guarantee.

tie_breakers.notes: UCAT Verbal Reasoning at least 600 was used for 14/25 shortlisting guidance and Verbal Reasoning is also documented as an offer-stage tie-breaker.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Executable generic classifier output is deliberately conservative for Home applicants because the PS score and UCAT-grade component are not available as supported Engine v1.0 inputs.

criteria: Refugee, asylum seeker or humanitarian protection
Armed Forces family or service leaver
adjustments: +1 shortlisting point in the UCAT-grade component
One full grade reduction in the A-level offer
guaranteed_interview_rules: Verified Steps2Medicine or UKWPMED completers only, provided minimum GCSE and UCAT/SJT requirements are met.
contextual_admissions.notes: No lower UCAT threshold is applied for contextual applicants.

ranking_pools.name: Home A100 applicants
ranking_pools.notes: Home places figure is for 2026 entry.

ranking_pools.name: International A100 applicants
ranking_pools.notes: International places figure is for 2026 entry.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.
A100 only. A104 has up to 20 separate places and is not included.

offer_selection.interview_format: Two separate 15-minute online interviews via Microsoft Teams.
offer_selection.interview_scoring: Interview performance is scored, but the public page does not publish the numerical rubric.
offer_selection.offer_model: Offer decisions are interview-based only; ApplySmart does not predict offers.
tie_breakers: UCAT Verbal Reasoning score where applicable
offer_selection.waiting_list_policy: Reserve list operates for candidates close to the offer threshold.
offer_selection.standard_offer: A*AA, or AAA plus EPQ grade A, subject rules unchanged.
offer_selection.contextual_offer: One full grade reduction for eligible contextual applicants; Steps2Medicine/UKWPMED offer is typically ABB where criteria are met.
offer_selection.notes: Offer prediction remains out of scope. This section records process transparency only.

cycles.interviews: Not broken out for A100; around 700 total interview invitations across A100 plus A104 target.

cycles.home_shortlisting_guidance: Around 15/25, with 14/25 possible if Verbal Reasoning >=600.

historical_admissions.notes: Multi-year UCAT interview data, offer-holder UCAT statistics, interview-to-offer conversion data, multi-year application statistics and International interviewed/offered UCAT ranges are retained as evidence gaps.

Applicant-group-specific UCAT minima are executable; Home /25 interview guidance remains transparently limited where Keele's personal-statement score is unavailable.

engine_assumptions: A104 is a separate course and is not evaluated through this A100 profile.
Contextual status adds Keele's documented shortlisting uplift and lower academic offer, not a lower UCAT threshold.
do_not_infer: Do not rank Home applicants by UCAT total alone.
Do not lower the contextual UCAT threshold below 1700.
Do not mix A104 gateway rules with A100.
Do not invent missing multi-year or International UCAT distributions.
supported_scope_limitations: ApplySmart cannot calculate Keele's Home /25 score because the personal-statement score and UCAT-grade quintile component are not supported component inputs.
International interview guidance uses Keele's UCAT-ranked selection model and the published 1950 minimum; unpublished International interviewed/offered UCAT ranges remain an evidence gap.
